purpose: Incremental evidence assessment for clean worker artifacts that appeared or changed after the initial 68-candidate base-state scan during the same comparator run.

new_or_materially_changed_assessments.title: OASIS online sample selection
new_or_materially_changed_assessments.reason: ACL 2026 primary; multiple models/streams, fixed-top-k and SOTA baselines, direct ORIS/SIREN component ablations, variance, and strong data-efficiency results. Public artifact/independent replication was not verified in this pass; paper itself has an internal forward-only wording inconsistency that the worker correctly scopes.

Primary benchmark gives broad quantitative separation between passive retrieval and active state-update/binding/revision demands plus error decomposition. Strong diagnostic evidence, but no intervention is isolated and aggregate comparisons are not a matched causal treatment.

Primary abstract confirms aligned context+environment rewind gains and a public benchmark framing, but exact headline/component numbers in the clean artifact came from indexed renderings rather than a primary table. Keep quantitative claims provisional until primary PDF/artifact verification.

Primary preprint abstract reports matched recovery improvements on a 150-case controlled benchmark and 50-case stress test with scoped claim-invalidation gains. Mechanism is plausible and quantitatively compared, but component ablations/reproduction are not yet established.

Controlled observed-state reuse and repeated intervention design directly shows a protocol-disambiguation intervention improving one model generation while reversing on another. High-value negative/failure-scope evidence; very recent preprint and limited task/model family prevent broader causal generalization.

Primary benchmark quantifies late-horizon degradation and evolving-state failure across 68 tasks/2,225 turns. Useful diagnostic evidence, but no recovery mechanism or matched intervention is demonstrated.

Peer-reviewed ICLR study provides quantitative 50-task comparisons, multiple seeds, learned-vs-explicit gating context and task-label-free test-time behavior. Evidence remains MNIST-derived, uses stored old inputs during training, and has no independent replication in the clean artifact.

New clean state strengthens reproducibility support with public author code/Zenodo artifact. No independent replication and exact supplementary natural-image values remain partly unextracted; tier stays A- rather than rising.

New same-lab extensions and an independent SNN preprint broaden mechanism corroboration, but they are not exact-method replication. Retain A- and scope to frozen-feature/no-old-data SRC rather than treating broad sleep replay as independently replicated.

new_or_materially_changed_assessments.title: Compile to Compress
new_or_materially_changed_assessments.reason: Primary preprint, fixed-budget comparisons across base provers/benchmarks, restart-vs-repair value routing, direct expert-iteration vs direct-SFT control, token accounting, and public code. No independent replication; some efficiency evidence is case-level rather than aggregate wall-clock.

new_or_materially_changed_assessments.title: Diversifying to Verify
new_or_materially_changed_assessments.reason: Primary preprint provides deliberate structural variants plus bounded verifier repair and task-level coverage. Missing same-compute comparison against four i.i.d. implementations leaves marginal structural-diversity causality unresolved.

new_or_materially_changed_assessments.title: APRIL Lean repair
new_or_materially_changed_assessments.reason: Large supervised repair dataset and strong matched repair-only accuracy show specialized diagnostic/repair learning, but evaluation shares the synthetic mutation family and end-to-end theorem-solving benefit is untested.

new_or_materially_changed_assessments.title: VeriSoftBench context selection
new_or_materially_changed_assessments.reason: Primary benchmark gives large cross-model curated-dependency vs full-repository gaps and strong scope diagnostics. Curated context uses ground-truth-proof dependencies, making it an oracle/best-case condition rather than evidence for a deployable retriever.

Primary study compares harness evolution against direct parallel/sequential search, unit-test access, and a disjoint train/val/held-out split. It directly limits same-benchmark evolution claims: only +0.6 average held-out in the reported split despite larger optimization-set gains.

Primary matched fixed-backbone evolution, component ablations, frozen transfer and regression-attribution diagnostics. Large Terminal-Bench gain does not transfer proportionally to SWE-bench; no independent replication established.

Primary cross-model/scaffold evidence strongly separates updater strength from downstream artifact activation/adherence, but many comparisons are across different solver/evolver capabilities rather than a single clean causal intervention.

Primary meta-on/off quantitative ablation across five environments with held-out sub-suite evidence and an informative near-zero NLE boundary. Very recent preprint; transfer and independent reproduction remain open.

Primary generated-suite benchmark uses held-out tasks, isolated containers, four agents/supervision modes, fixed-agent creator comparisons and cross-domain negative-transfer cells. Causal axis of creator complexity vs supervision is useful, but generated-suite realism/replication remain open.

Primary full-vs-partial curriculum ablations, checkpoint retention and held-out diagnostic separation support targeted repair + anti-forgetting + end-to-end rehearsal as a system package. Individual contribution of router/checkpoint/GRPO is not fully isolated and external transfer is mixed.

New MLReplicate evidence strengthens the already-high-confidence full-artifact-audit need: manuscript-only automated ratings correlate weakly with humans and unsupported claims survive automated acceptance. This is still audit-need evidence, not a tested online auditor intervention.
AIRS/AI Scientist branching evidence remains strong but not universally dominant; expert-slice exception and incomplete same-model budget matching prevent causal upgrade.
ASI-Bench guidance-gradient numbers strengthen the procedure-synthesis bottleneck diagnosis; direct procedure-compiler intervention remains untested.
Cross-benchmark failure taxonomies strengthen plan-execution-evidence consistency as an intervention hypothesis, but a matched verifier/repair ablation is still absent.

Peer-reviewed NAACL primary with reference/entity ablations and bounded-refinement saturation. Strong for idea-generation quality within literature tasks, but no end-to-end discovery/reproducibility bridge.
Primary matched skill-package additions show proposal/synthesis gains and experiment/coding regressions. Atomic skill contributions and cross-model replication are unresolved.
Direct benchmark ablation gives a large proposal-stage drop when inspiration is removed, but the benchmark supplies the pivot; autonomous generation/selection of valid pivots is untested.

Peer-reviewed primary system with programmatic backtracing and high simple-task recapitulation rates. Complexity-dependent degradation and lack of an isolated provenance-vs-no-provenance causal ablation limit transfer.

Multiple primary systems show resource/quality non-monotonicity and within-workflow reasoning scaling, strongly rejecting raw compute as a universal quality proxy. Cross-system architecture/model confounding prevents a stronger causal ranking.

Primary simulation study reports 14,600 vs 330,000 evaluation budget for 99% correct selection in a 210-design problem. Very strong original scoped result; transfer to stochastic agent/research evaluation and finite-budget robustness remain unverified.

Peer-reviewed primary with passive-learning/control baselines and 47.7% faster correct-model selection in a nonlinear bioreactor simulation. Strong original active-identification mechanism; transfer remains a hypothesis.

OSDI production deployment plus trace-driven simulation, explicit prior-scheme comparison, resource/copy-success metrics and multiple scoped interventions. Strong systems evidence for cause-aware restart/duplicate/protect policy, though agent-research transfer is indirect.

Primary dissertation/case evidence strongly supports low-overhead sparse instrumentation and statistical localization; matched diagnosis-time/localization-entropy reduction and transfer to research agents are not established.

Primary controlled localized perturbations, human validation, category counts and fine-grained-vs-holistic protocol differences strengthen the existing controlled-intervention metaevaluation family. Natural interactive failure coverage and cost frontier remain incomplete.

KDD primary benchmark with 1,000 trajectories/8,509 labeled steps, first-error vs step-accuracy diagnostics, long-horizon degradation and direct Best-of-8 outcome->process selection gains across every listed generator; protocol-dependent error-propagation ablation gives useful negative scope.

TMLR controlled multi-judge/multi-benchmark study with nine mitigation strategies, bias counterfactuals, cost comparisons and Holm-Bonferroni-surviving gains. Contradiction with JudgeSense correctly bounds universal bias claims.

COLM primary benchmark with expert labels across five web environments, strong IAA and precision/recall/F1 comparison of rules vs LLM judges. It validates evaluator failure across heterogeneous trajectories but does not isolate one universal evaluator intervention.

Primary preprint uses 494 validated semantic paraphrase pairs and exposes polarity/order artifacts and wide stability variation. No intervention establishes a universally robust judge, and protocol contradictions are material.

Matched verifier-guided search vs repeated sampling under increasing budgets directly demonstrates scale-dependent reversals and selection-stage failure. Workshop/preprint status and math-domain scope prevent universal search conclusions.

Controlled isomorphic-perturbation and training experiments show extensional verifier shortcuts; shortcut prevalence rises with complexity and is eliminated by isomorphic verification in the tested setup. Scope is specific inductive-rule RLVR.

Primary verifier study directly separates improved static precision/recall from downstream RL outcomes, including reward-oracle divergence and regressions. Strong negative causal evidence against treating fixed-set verifier accuracy as an optimization-safety proxy.

Manual audit of successful SWE-Agent+GPT-4 patches quantifies answer leakage/weak-oracle false success and large corrected-score drops. Strong benchmark-integrity evidence, scoped to audited successes and benchmark versions.

Cross-benchmark localization probe gives large SWE-bench-Verified advantage consistent with memory/exposure, but proprietary training data are unobservable and dataset difficulty confounds remain; circumstantial rather than proof of memorization.

Large 1,968-task adversarial audit with held-out/public exploits and stronger adaptive attackers directly shows outcome-verifier hackability and partial hardening; residual Terminal-Bench attack success preserves scope.

Primary preprint provides target-task verifier-rubric measurement, 3.4–10.9 pp regressions under self-DPO despite decreasing loss, and replication on a second student. Single-author/recent status and VLM-specific scope limit consensus strength.

TMLR WAREX uses matched no-fault/network/server perturbations across three web benchmarks and shows large controlled drops plus incomplete generic-prompt recovery. Strong reliability evidence within tested fault models.

ICLR HAL log audit identifies concrete official-scaffold test leakage and explicitly invalidates affected evaluations. This is high-confidence benchmark-integrity failure evidence despite being a single affected scaffold.

ICLR HAL analyzes 1,634 transcripts and finds environment/scaffold barriers in roughly 40% of failed tasks in three benchmarks. Observational statistic is strong for attribution confounding but not a causal universal failure rate.

ICLR HAL matched cells show higher reasoning effort equal or worse in 21/36 comparisons, directly bounding monotonic inference-compute claims; mechanisms behind cell-level reversals remain unresolved.
Primary ECAI study gives node+edge pruning ablations, fixed-team negative boundary and large token reductions. Mostly text benchmarks/gpt-4o-mini and no independent replication.

Heuresis holds the research-agent loop fixed across six search strategies with 300 executions per strategy/domain and held-out retests. Directly shows MAP-Elites is landscape-dependent and includes reward-hacking audit; strong negative/conditional evidence.
Peer-reviewed ACL AgentDropout gives learned node/edge component ablations, random-drop controls and a pruning-rate accuracy/token frontier, directly rejecting maximum pruning.
Primary project reports strong QD/adversary-history effects but accessible MAP-Elites ablation lacks numeric delta and specialist robustness has no full matched decomposition.

Equal total LLM-call budget supports heterogeneous ensemble QD gains over single/homogeneous search, including held-out generality. Model-family heterogeneity is confounded with cheaper within-model diversity axes and Core War scope is narrow.

Peer-reviewed ACL Findings provides direct model-heterogeneity × topology decomposition, group-size efficiency collapse, prompt/persona ablation and a negative horizontal-topology cell. Strong evidence that heterogeneity is conditional on structural coupling; ideation scope remains explicit.

Continuation strengthens implementation-level evidence: public Memento path performs unconditional top-k retrieval with no confidence/admission gate, while EvoAgentBench has a severe negative-transfer cell. Causal linkage is still blocked because the benchmark omits the third-party adapter/config; therefore no tier increase beyond A- and no claim that forced retrieval caused the reported regression.

candidate_id_integrity_issue.problem: The 18:01 clean artifact reuses candidate IDs sci-agent-clean-g1-005 through -008 for mechanisms that are semantically different from the mechanisms carrying those same IDs in the earlier 17:02 artifact/base comparator state.
candidate_id_integrity_issue.comparator_action: Do not overwrite or merge the earlier base candidates by raw ID. This delta assigns source-scoped comparator IDs sci-1801-* to the new meanings. Downstream canonicalization must treat artifact-path/version + semantic mechanism as identity until the worker repairs its durable candidate IDs. No writeback to the worker is permitted by this comparator role.

primary_spot_checks.result: Confirmed archival ACL 2026 publication and the core claim that OASIS uses stream-relative informativeness plus redundancy-aware selection; 25% data is reported comparable to full-data training.
Confirmed the primary learning-to-refine/verifier-feedback tree-search framing and comparable-budget PutnamBench claim; a public C2C-Lean-Prover repository is also available.
Confirmed target-task verifier accuracy 8–23%, 3.4–10.9 pp student regressions, decreasing DPO loss, and replication on Qwen-2.5-VL-3B.

Confirmed WAREX evaluates controlled web/network failure injection across WebArena, WebVoyager and REAL and reports large task-success drops; exact table values remain source-version scoped to the worker's primary extraction.
Confirmed diversity-collapse framing: group-size diminishing returns, authority/dense topology contraction and interaction-structure dominance; paper links public code.

material_cross_cutting_updates: The clean evidence base now has repeated direct evidence that adaptive allocation beats unconditional scaling: replay amount, sample selection, agent count/edges, search-vs-repair budget, outer search strategy, reasoning effort, and verifier-guided candidate count all exhibit non-monotonic or task-dependent regimes.

Evaluation integrity is now a first-class evidence variable, not a downstream hygiene detail: verifier exploitation, official-scaffold leakage, weak test oracles, environment faults, and infrastructure barriers can all materially invert or inflate apparent capability.

A candidate identifier cannot be trusted as stable identity across worker checkpoints without semantic/provenance checking. The scientist_agents ID collision is concrete evidence that downstream integration must canonicalize by semantic mechanism + source provenance and preserve artifact version.
exact_continuation: On the next comparator pass, rescan clean worker artifact SHAs before grading. First resolve any new/changed artifacts after the SHAs recorded here. Then prioritize primary-table verification where current tiers hinge on indexed/non-primary exact numbers (especially LH-AgentRewind) and independent replication/failure evidence for A/A- candidates. Preserve the scientist_agents candidate-ID collision explicitly until a later clean artifact introduces stable unique IDs; never write back to the worker. Keep legacy research_workers/ excluded and O unread unless a narrow evidence/configuration comparison genuinely requires it.
